findings: P2 — src/player.ts:101,130-137: Guard app-originated initial result notifications after the request promise finishes. activeCountryRequest is cleared in finally, after which any kind=initial notification is accepted unconditionally. A delayed/duplicate host notification from an older picker request can overwrite the newer country and call player.clearSelection, stopping newer playback. Delivered-bundle probe shows US playing becoming GB idle with source removed. Promise serial checks do not protect this route. Distinguish/correlate picker completions from fresh chat-originated results, and test late and duplicate notifications after the latest picker promise has settled, including same-country results.

P2 — src/player.ts:87-101,128: Restore usable controls on country-request failure. Starting a country request clears pending but never refreshes controls; if an old Retry was in flight, its button is disabled and its finally no longer matches pending. When the new country request fails or returns malformed data, no acceptInitial/refreshControls occurs, leaving Retry disabled indefinitely despite a retained partial catalog. The selector also remains on the failed country while old-country choices remain, so the instruction to choose the same country again does not trigger a native change event. Reconcile selector and retained catalog, offer a real retry path, and refresh controls on cancellation/failure; add a delayed Retry plus failed picker regression.
